prompts.text: Produce one transparent game effects sprite atlas on a strict 4 columns × 2 rows equally sized square grid, exactly 8 isolated separate effects. No character, no lines between cells, no background, floor, text or labels. Each effect fully inside its cell, at least 12% clear margin. Rich blackberry violet, amber gold glow, forest green accents, readable at small size, polished painted storybook fantasy. Top row left to right: curved translucent faceted amber glass shield arc; plum-and-gold looping curved pull ribbon; low right-pointing blackberry speed ribbon with dust; low oval blackberry puddle with a subtle golden healing ripple. Bottom row: hovering amber spiral with three berry sparks for ultimate charge; expansive burst of three jam-violet arcs with amber sparks for ultimate release; celebratory warm seal ring and gold sparkles; tight sharp plum glass impact burst. Clean alpha edges. No square glows or raster halos outside the effects.

Produce one clean landscape 4 column × 2 row equal grid transparent sprite atlas, eight separately centered isolated objects with generous 15 percent margin. No figure, no labels or lines. Each row holds a sequence of four rotations of one game projectile. Top row: a SMALL round brown-purple blackberry jam glass jar with a beige tied cloth lid, cream sticker with berry icon only, reflections of light; 4 angles/rotations (upright, 25 degrees, 60, 100), same jar. Bottom row: the charged variant with a gold orange ribbon and brighter berry red glass; same four different rotations. Match the Bilbo painted storybook shading. Actual transparent everything around jars, no ground, motion lines, particle effects, other objects or baked trail.

Make 2 isolated inventory objects on transparent alpha, side-by-side in two evenly sized squares, aspect ratio 2:1. Left is the reference merchant's squat round glass jar full of purple blackberry preserve with folded cream cloth tied by twine; warm amber light, real glossy purple glass, cream berry icon label with no letters. Right is a tiny warm cream parchment order slip with a simple berry stamp and three hand-drawn checkbox marks, no letters. No hands, people, backgrounds, extra items, drop shadows, or dividing lines. Generous padding, soft painted storybook game art matching reference.
